name: FSI Agentic AI Operating Model Workflow
serviceNowSurface: AI Agent Studio plus Now Assist Panel, AI Control Tower, and CMDB/CSDM read-only analysis
trigger: Executive or platform owner asks how to use ServiceNow AI agents against FSI operating priorities
businessOutcome: Turn agentic AI ideas into a governed operating model that increases adoption velocity and supports a credible expansion case.
steps: Force the outcome metric, value hypothesis, owner, and decision needed before architecture work begins.
Map the request to OOTB Now Assist and AI Agent Studio surfaces before proposing custom agent build.
Assess CMDB/CSDM service ownership and data readiness needed for trustworthy agent execution.
Prioritize candidate agentic workflows by value, feasibility, adoption path, and governance risk.
Define the operating model: owners, weekly cadence, enablement loop, adoption metrics, and go/no-go thresholds.
Design AI Control Tower controls for discovery, observability, governance, security, measurement, and kill switch.
Create the pilot plan with human approval gates, rollback path, audit events, and test cases.
Produce the executive expansion narrative connecting operating model, adoption velocity, and revenue/value expansion.
approvalPoints: Before enabling production triggers or write actions
Before using customer-specific value numbers in executive material
Before connecting external agents, MCP gateways, or third-party model providers
Before publishing readiness scores outside the platform team
failureStates: No named owner for the workflow or agent
No baseline metric or source quality for the value claim
CMDB/CSDM data trust below advisory threshold
No audit or rollback path for an action-capable agent
Custom agent proposed while OOTB Now Assist covers the workflow at lower risk
auditNotes: Record prompt/template version, workflow version, model/provider, data source, tool calls, approvals, blocked actions, and user-visible output.
Separate verified facts, benchmark assumptions, and hypotheses in every value narrative.
Keep secrets and credentials out of prompts, Markdown, logs, screenshots, and demo artifacts.
tests: Missing owner returns a no-go and remediation ask.
Read-only data readiness assessment produces recommendations but no CMDB writes.
Workflow with no approval gate cannot use write actions.
Value claim without source is downgraded to hypothesis.
OOTB Now Assist match must be considered before custom agent build.
